- animal_population_get_history(country, species, years)
- animal_population_get_projection(country, species, years)

Thus total four function calls.

We should do them sequentially. We'll first call animal_population_get_history for Bangladesh, species tiger, years 5. Then for India. Then projection for Nepal, species tiger, years 10. Then projection for Malaysia.
